Contact-free check-in
Eldborg Campsite does not have a reception. Check-in is contact-free, so you can arrive and settle in without visiting a reception desk.

If you have any questions or run into any problems during your stay, you are always welcome to contact us by phone or email**. We are happy to help.

Camping areas
The campsite does not have designated individual pitches. When booking, you choose between two camping areas:

*Zone A – No electricity*
For guests who do not require an electrical connection.

*Zone B – Electricity available*
Zone B has 3 electrical connections and is limited to 3 bookings.

After arrival, guests are free to choose any available camping or parking spot on the campsite, regardless of which zone they booked. If you have booked Zone B but would prefer to park or camp in another area, you are welcome to do so and your electrical connection will remain available.

License plate
If you do not know your vehicle’s license plate number when making your booking, simply enter “ADD LATER” in the license plate field.
You can add your license plate number later through the Parka check-in option when you are on your way or after you have arrived at the campsite.

During periods of heavy rain:
When the ground becomes very wet or muddy, we ask guests to avoid parking on the grass in order to protect the campsite. During these periods, guests are welcome to park closer to the white house on the more suitable hard-surface areas. This gives guests a convenient alternative while helping us keep the campsite in good condition.
